name: api-crapi
description: OWASP crAPI — the OWASP-governed vulnerable API. Ground truth is OWASP's OWN published vulnerability list (13 flaws across 6 OWASP API Top 10 categories), not a list we wrote. crAPI's flaws are modelled on real bugs disclosed at Facebook, Uber and Shopify, which makes it a stronger external target than a fixture we author. Deploy: curl the compose from OWASP/crAPI and `docker compose up -d`; web on :8888.

competitors.note: No neutral API-security leaderboard exists (unlike WAVSEP/OWASP-Benchmark). crAPI and VAmPI are the OWASP-recognised reference targets; the OWASP API Security Testing Framework validates against crAPI, VAmPI and DVGA, so they are the de-facto community bar.

ground_truth_note: must_find carries only what an L1 anchor scan can surface unaided, because a fixture that can never pass is a permanently-red gate rather than a measurement. The full 13 are recorded below as the honest denominator — the gap between must_find and documented_vulnerabilities is the backlog, not something defined away.

documented_vulnerabilities.flaw: Unauthorized access to another user's vehicle details
documented_vulnerabilities.covered_by: bola_probe / apiauthz — needs two declared identities (operator TestConfig)

documented_vulnerabilities.flaw: Sensitive user information leaked in a response
documented_vulnerabilities.covered_by: NOT COVERED — no L1 detector for over-broad response bodies
NOT COVERED — needs load generation, not pattern matching

documented_vulnerabilities.flaw: Deleting another user's video via the admin endpoint
HTTP call forwarding in the mechanic service
documented_vulnerabilities.covered_by: nuclei ssrf tag + DAST/OAST escalation — L1 anchor

documented_vulnerabilities.flaw: Coupon code bypass via NoSQL injection
documented_vulnerabilities.covered_by: PARTIAL — the api nuclei tag set carries sqli/injection, but NoSQL injection is a distinct payload family

documented_vulnerabilities.flaw: Two vulnerabilities OWASP deliberately does not document
documented_vulnerabilities.covered_by: unknown by construction — excluded from any recall denominator
